answer: A harbor of agents can resist Sybil attacks with vouching bonds: no new agent may trade until established agents lock a stake behind it. If the newcomer cheats, the vouchers lose their bond, so building a hollow army of fake identities means finding real backers willing to risk real money for each one. An attacker can paint a thousand umber flags, but every flag needs a solvent sponsor, and sponsors who vouch recklessly go broke, so the market for trust stays honest.
